text:
Emma: FYI I opened PR #842 — migration guide for Private + Rust SDK snippet. Netlify preview link is showing a missing image and a couple of inline code formatting regressions :grimacing:
Jia: link? can take a quick look :eyes:
Emma: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/13579 (preview included in PR) — asset /assets/sdk-rust.png 404, and in the snippets the fenced block lost the rust highlight so it renders as plain text
Ben: looks like the asset path is being rewritten by the build plugin. I hit this before when base_url was different in mkdocs.yml
Sam: which mkdocs-theme/version? Netlify sometimes strips leading slashes depending on our build env var
Emma: mkdocs-material 9.0.1, mkdocs 1.4.3. I used a relative path in the md: ![sdk image](/assets/sdk-rust.png)
Marta: quick workaround: change to relative-without-leading-slash: ![sdk image](assets/sdk-rust.png) — that fixed it locally for me once. Also double-check site_url in mkdocs.yml for previews
Jia: for the fenced code highlight, PR is using ```rust but Netlify's python-markdown extension version on the preview runner is older; we saw the same when previews used the cached build image. Deploy-bot might have more details
deploy-bot: Build 13579 finished: failed (exit code 1). Logs: "ERROR: 404 for /assets/sdk-rust.png". Using cached build image: redwood/doc-preview:20260318.
Ben: suggestion: update the image path in the PR to the non-leading-slash relative path, push, then re-run preview. If that fixes, we can merge during the midday merge window. Otherwise we need to bump the preview image in the assets pipeline
Emma: pushed fix in branch (changed to assets/sdk-rust.png) and added an inline note: "Local preview: mkdocs serve (mkdocs 1.4.3) — run with `python -m http.server 8000` only if building static assets first"
Sam: small nit: the Rust snippet uses async fn example but our SDK's async runtime note isn't in the snippet. Can we add a one-line comment showing tokio feature usage?
Emma: yep added: // requires tokio = { version = "1", features = ["rt-multi-thread"] } — kept it short
Jia: re-running preview now
deploy-bot: Rebuild triggered for PR #842 by Jia. Build 13580 queued.
Ben: if 13580 passes, who will approve? I can do a quick docs review and then hand to Marta for final approval on the migration checklist items
Marta: I can approve after I confirm the example is accurate w.r.t. Private deploy config. Give me 30m
Emma: thanks! ping me if the preview still 404s. I left a short local checklist in the PR description for reviewers (how to replicate with mkdocs serve + env var overrides)
Jia: Build 13580 succeeded. Preview link: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/13580 — assets resolved :tada:
Ben: reviewing now, focusing on wording and the migration checklist. Will leave a single comment about change log placement
Marta: confirmed the Rust snippet matches the Private deploy auth note. Approving now :white_check_mark:
Ben: approved — merging in the midday merge window (12:30 PT) :thumbsup:
Emma: merging after 12:30 then. Thanks all!
Sam: noted for future: add a small CI healthcheck that scans for absolute asset paths in docs before build to catch this earlier
Emma: opened follow-up issue #291 to add the healthcheck.
